name: Two Plus One Poker
description: Guts-style poker variant. Each player is dealt two cards; players declare in or out; those who are in receive a third card. Hands rank as in Three-card Guts (three of a kind, straight flush, straight, flush, pair, nothing). Losers who stayed in match the pot.

content.text: Guts-style poker variant. Each player is dealt two cards; players declare in or out; those who are in receive a third card. Hands rank as in Three-card Guts (three of a kind, straight flush, straight, flush, pair, nothing). Losers who stayed in match the pot.
Guts-style match-pot poker variant. Each player dealt two cards, declare in or out, those in receive a third card; hands rank as Three-card Guts.
Two cards face down to each player, one at a time. After declarations, one card to each player who declared in.

items.text: Second declare with extra ante: Those who stay in for a third card pay an extra ante and take part in a second round of declaring in or out when they have three cards. Players who stay in for the third card but drop out after seeing it lose the extra ante but do not risk matching the pot.
